verdict.core_claim: Remote work creates complex tax and legal compliance issues (tax nexus) for companies that will eventually force major legal reforms.
verdict.rationale: This submission introduces a substantive new angle regarding the administrative and legal friction of remote work, specifically 'tax nexus' and payroll obligations across jurisdictions. While the pool discusses the economic results of location-free work (s5, s40), it does not address the regulatory 'plumbing' that makes it difficult for companies to implement. This is a fresh, relevant insight that identifies a concrete structural barrier to the remote work revolution.
